title: SSE conversation stream events (v1)
description:
Server-Sent Events emitted by POST /conversations/stream. Each frame is 'event: <name>
data: <json>

'. All events below are versioned together.

oneOf.title: heartbeat
oneOf.description: Keepalive ping; ``data`` is always an empty object ``{}``.

oneOf.title: redaction
oneOf.description: Output moderation halted the stream before the tail reached the client (P4-3). Followed by the terminal ``error`` / ``result`` frame.

oneOf.title: retraction
oneOf.description: Output moderation truncated a stream that had already released deltas: the client must discard everything after ``retract_from_event_id`` (Last-Event-ID resume point) and render the terminal frame instead. Always preceded/followed by the matching ``redaction`` frame.

oneOf.title: compaction
oneOf.description: Emitted at stream open when the thread already carries a durable compaction checkpoint: ``position`` is the seq of the last summarized message (every earlier turn is replaced by the summary block) and ``layer_count`` is the number of byte-stable summary layers (P2-6). Client may render a compaction marker.

oneOf.title: error
oneOf.description: Terminal failure. ``error`` is a human-readable reason; for a gateway rejection ``kind`` and ``status`` are added, and a budget rejection (P5-7) additionally carries ``level``/``limit_usd``/``projected_usd`` so the surface UI can render a distinct budget-blocked state.
